item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:45 HKT 05/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over the coast of southern China in the next few days. An upper-air disturbance will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. With the upper-air disturbance departing, the weather will be mainly fine over Guangdong early to midweek next week. An easterly airstream is expected to affect southeastern China in the latter part of next week.
